title: LED Pixels
description: An addressable LED rig simulated pixel by pixel — strip, ring, matrix or spiral wired in serpentine order, running rainbow / chase / sparkle / VU / fire / plasma patterns with diffusion bloom. Dimmer, hue, speed and spread ship pre-mapped to Art-Net channels 1–4 (npm run artnet-bridge): while a desk is sending, its faders take each of those over its full range, and the panel values return when it goes quiet. Mic level drives the VU meter.
